Resolves #19549

Related: #14800 (the v13.2 cut order's unowned dock-polish leaf), #16756 / #16498 (the arm's origin).

Ada's "restored pane lands ~12 px off baseline" is the baseline, not the restore: the arm armed its sampler ~100 ms after the Audit tab click while the boot's dock motion was still easing the Audit pane (258 → 268 px through the four-frame roomy-start station; 280.5 px once settled, exactly what the restore returns). A warm second run in one browser process reaches the click earlier in that motion, which is why the arm passed once and failed every time after. The witness now waits for a settled room before recording the baseline: no `neo-dashboard-dock-animating` on the dock and every target pane's rect identical across eight presented frames (bounded at 240 frames; on timeout the failure names the moving pane). Test-only.

Evidence: L3 (headless e2e, the arm ×3 in one process at `dev` 5698517f19 plus this change) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-4). No residual.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `WorkstationTearOutSourceContinuityNL.spec.mjs -g "no-drag native place-cycle" --repeat-each=3`: 3/3 in 37 s (Test Evidence); before the change the same command failed on run 2 with 12.027 px |
| AC-2 | `waitRoomSettled` resolves `{animating, frames, rects, settled}` and the assertion prints it on timeout |
| AC-3 | the diff touches one spec file |
| AC-4 | the gate counts presented frames and reads the motion signal; no `waitForTimeout`, no wall-clock constant |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The compact and restored stations keep their existing frame waits: each station records its last frame, the restored band is 6.2 s long, and the compact comparison is an inequality.

## Test Evidence
- Before: `--repeat-each=2` at `dev` 5698517f19 → run 1 green, run 2 red (`audit: restored pane geometry must return to baseline`, received 12.027496337890625); the attached receipts show Audit's roomy-start frames at 258.06, 258.06, 263.71, 268.47 px and the restored band at 280.48 → 280.5 px, the other three panes settled throughout.
- After: `--repeat-each=3` → 3/3 (37.3 s).
